    # check if L is empty, if so return 0
    if L == []:
        return 0
    # take all albums from L that have genre S
    subset = []
    for album in L:
        if album["genre"] == S:
            subset.append(album)
    # check if subset is empty, if so return -1
    if subset == []:
        return -1
    # take the average rating of all albums in subset
    total = 0.0
